{{Top|rwm|can|fotj}} {{Youmay|the television episode|[[The Clone Wars: The Holocron Heist|its young readers companion book]]}} {{TelevisionEpisode |image=[[File:Epguide201.png]] |title="Holocron Heist" |series=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}} |season=[[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Two]] |episode=1 |production=1.23 |screener= |airdate=[[October 2]], [[2009]] |intl release= |runtime=24 minutes |director=[[Justin Ridge]] |writer=*[[Paul Dini]] *[[Scott Murphy]] {{C|Staff writer}} |production company= |guests= |canon_timeline=[[21 BBY]]{{TCWcanondates|201}} |legends_timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]{{TCWdates|201}} |prev="[[Hostage Crisis]]" |next="[[Cargo of Doom]]" }} {{Quote|A lesson learned is a lesson earned.|Moral|}} "'''Holocron Heist'''" is the premiere episode for [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It is the twenty-third episode of the series overall and is the first of a three-part storyline. The episode is chronologically preceded by the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] episode "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]." ==Official description== ''Cad Bane infiltrates the Jedi Temple and attempts to steal an ancient Jedi Holocron. It's up to Ahsoka, Anakin, and Obi-Wan to stop the bounty hunter from escaping with the valuable Jedi artifact.'' ==Opening narration== {{OpeningCrawl |name=Episode 1
HOLOCRON HEIST |text=Jedi trapped on Felucia! Clones are surrounded by droid forces. Their only hope is to escape on Republic gunships waiting to land on the embattled surface. Jedi cruisers have managed to blow a hole in the droid defenses, and have sent gunships to the rescue.}} ==Plot summary== {{Quote|To get a holocron, I'd have to break into the Jedi Temple. It's impossible, not to mention deadly.|Cad Bane, to Darth Sidious|}} On [[Felucia]], Jedi [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|Cruisers]] arrive to [[First Battle of Felucia|evacuate]] the planet. Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|gunships]], escorted by a fighter squadron commanded by [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] break through the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Felucia blockade|blockade]] surrounding [[Felucia]] to evacuate [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], and their troops. The former are outnumbered, with droids closing in on them. However, Ahsoka is elsewhere, sending a pack of droids running. Obi-Wan explains to the [[Padawan]] through the [[comlink]] that the group she is chasing are regrouping with the main force and orders her to retreat; Ahsoka is in disbelief that her Master is telling her to run and is insistent on continuing; Anakin brings his gunship in front of her and orders her and her troops to get on. Later, at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], Anakin and Ahsoka are before the [[Jedi High Council|Council]] for the latter's lack of foresight. The Council sends Ahsoka to the [[Jedi Archives]] for guard duty, under Madame [[Jocasta Nu]]'s watchful eye. Jocasta tells Ahsoka that she has a specific duty to defend the [[Holocron Vault]], where the [[Jedi Order|Order]] keeps their collection of [[holocron]]s; only Council members are allowed in. Elsewhere on Coruscant, [[Cad Bane]] is contacted by [[Darth Sidious]], who hires him to steal a holocron from the Temple; Bane considers it suicide, as the Temple is well guarded; Sidious assures him that he will ensure that he will gain entrance; Bane demands in return a stealth ship with elite weapons, cloaking device and triple his usual pay. He then places a device in his helper droid, [[Todo 360]], under the pretense of fixing a system crash. Bane also installs a security chip into Todo, giving him access to all the temple security measures. His partner, [[Cato Parasitti]], a [[Clawdite]] bounty hunter, then arrives. Bane tells her to [[Holographic disguise matrix|take the form]] of Jedi Master [[Ord Enisence]], whose corpse is in his room, to help him gain access to the vault. At the Temple, during a briefing, [[Yoda]] senses a shift in [[the Force]] and determines that thieves will arrive at the Temple. Anakin and Obi-Wan inaccurately deduce that their enemies are after their transmission codes and go to secure their location. Meanwhile, Cato infiltrates the Temple disguised as Ord. However, she is barred by Ahsoka, who asks if "Ord" needs help; Cato tries waving her off but the Padawan's pestering results in her snapping at Ahsoka. She then gains access to the Temple's schematics, telling Bane and Todo where to get in. They get through the shielding and the fans, before coming up upon a laser grid. Anakin and Obi-Wan quickly catch on when the sensors begins a blackout. Meanwhile, Jocasta approaches Cato as Master Ord at her console, asking why "Ord" is working when the Temple is on high alert; Cato responds by knocking her out and taking her appearance. She then returns to her work, telling Bane how to disable the lasers, while Todo cuts a hole into the ventilation system. Ahsoka is alerted by Yoda and confronts the impostor. When Cato attacks her, Ahsoka defends herself and engages Cato in a [[lightsaber duel]]. After a brief chase, Ahsoka captures Cato. Because of Cato's preoccupation, Bane detonates a small charge by the grid, as the Jedi follow Todo's trail. The droid soon arrives in the communication center, at which time a beeping is heard from him. [[Mace Windu]] quickly realizes that there is a bomb inside him and [[Telekinesis|Force-pushes]] him into the vent as he explodes; Anakin and Obi-Wan get away just in time. Ahsoka then contacts them, having learned from Cato that Bane is after the Vault. However, Bane had completed his objective and had snuck out of the Temple with a holocron, disguising himself with a [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robe]]. However, Cato gives one more clue: [[Bolla Ropal]]. Windu realizes that Bane is after the out of contact Jedi who is the keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal|Kyber crystal]], that with the holocron could crack the data on the crystal, which contains information, listing all the [[Force-sensitive]] children in the galaxy; the future of the [[Jedi Order]]. Obi-Wan stays on Coruscant to search for Bane while Anakin and Ahsoka track down Ropal in the [[Devaron system]]. ==Continuity== The Jedi Temple Archives feature on [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|The Complete Season Two]] Blu-ray includes the deleted scenes "Todo Decoding Jedi Temple Shield," "Jedi Temple on High Alert" and "Bane Giving Todo Orders." The music in the opening [[First Battle of Felucia|fight]] on [[Felucia]] is the edited score of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (soundtrack)|Battle of Christophsis]], first heard in [[The Clone Wars: Season One]], Episode 16 "[[The Hidden Enemy]]." In chronological order this story arc marks the first appearance of bounty hunter Cad Bane. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from Holocron Heist|imagecat=Images from Holocron Heist}}
